card.name: Incompatible in IV drug mixing
card.fires_on: The word incompatible, or its start (In-compat), in injection labels about mixing drugs with IV solutions or other drugs.

modes.label: Full word incompatible
modes.description: The whole word 'incompatible' after 'is' or 'to be' when naming solutions or drugs a product cannot be mixed with.
modes.example: VIDAZA is<< incompatible>> with 5% Dextrose Injection

modes.label: Start of Incompatibility
modes.description: The 'compat' piece in a heading such as Incompatibility or Incompatibilities.
modes.example: Cefepime for Injection Admixture In<<compat>>ibility Do not add solutions of cef

card.plain: It marks the point in an injection label where the text says a drug cannot be mixed with certain fluids or drugs.
